parameter_rationale.familiarity: The no-analogue indicator and its Q90 threshold are reused unchanged from the prior training-only familiarity analysis.
parameter_rationale.tie_rule: The deterministic trajectory-ID top-10 rule is fixed before this stratified analysis and does not depend on endpoint outcomes.
parameter_rationale.interpretation: Intervals are unadjusted post-hoc descriptive summaries and do not test a prespecified interaction.
